# oag (OpenAPI Generator)

> OpenAPI 3.x code generator. Generates TypeScript/Node API clients, React/SWR hooks, and Python FastAPI server stubs. Template pack engine with Jinja2 templates and TOML manifests. Packs install locally to `.oag/packs/`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/README.md): Install, CLI, configuration, examples
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Architecture and development guide
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Version history
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup and workflow

## API / Key Files

- [crates/oag-core/src/](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/crates/oag-core/src/): IR, parser, config, transform pipeline
- [crates/oag-cli/src/main.rs](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/crates/oag-cli/src/main.rs): CLI entry point
- [packs/](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/packs/): Template packs (node-client, react-swr-client, fastapi-server)
- [crates/oag-core/default-config.yaml](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/crates/oag-core/default-config.yaml): Default oag.yaml config
- [examples/](https://github.com/urmzd/oag/blob/main/examples/): Working examples (petstore, sse-chat)
